projectBackground.name: Hospital Cost Plan — New Diagnostic Block
projectBackground.context: The package cost plan needs verification and the contractor has submitted a variation claim.

manager.name: Helen Marsh
manager.note: Every figure traces to a quantity and a rate. If I can't see your working, it's an opinion.

assignment.title: Verify the cost plan and value the variation
assignment.brief: Measure concrete, build up the cost plan, price a BoQ in Excel and value variations.

documents.name: Drawing Extract
documents.note: Slab 12 m x 8 m x 0.2 m thick; concrete £140 per m³; waste 7%.

documents.name: Cost Build-up
documents.note: Base cost £100,000; preliminaries 12%; contingency 5% on the subtotal.

documents.name: Variation Instruction
documents.note: Omit 200 m² at £25; add 150 m² at £40.

tasks.title: Concrete Volume with Waste
tasks.prompt: Slab 12 x 8 x 0.2 m with 7% waste. What is the ordered volume (m³, 2 decimals)?
tasks.reasoning: Measure net, then add allowances explicitly.
tasks.mistake: Burying waste in the rate hides it.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Cost Plan Total
tasks.prompt: Base £100,000; preliminaries 12% of base; contingency 5% on (base + preliminaries). What is the total (£)?
tasks.reasoning: Percentages build on the right subtotal.
tasks.tip: Document the basis of each add-on.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Variation Value
tasks.prompt: Omit 200 m² at £25 and add 150 m² at £40. What is the net variation (£, positive = addition)?
tasks.reasoning: Variation = additions less omissions at contract rates.
tasks.tip: Value using contract rates where applicable.
tasks.mistake: Netting areas before pricing is wrong.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Purpose of a BoQ
tasks.prompt: What is a Bill of Quantities for?
options: Giving all bidders the same measured quantities to price
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Priced BoQ (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Amount (D = B x C) for each item. Upload for checking.
tasks.tip: Check units match the rate basis.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Cost Report
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence cost report note.
tasks.modelAnswer: The package cost plan totals £117,600: £100,000 base, £12,000 preliminaries and £5,600 contingency. The variation instruction is a net addition of £1,000 valued at contract rates. Concrete quantities include a 7% waste allowance (20.54 m³). I recommend retaining contingency until the foundation design is finalised and reporting any further variations monthly.
tasks.reasoning: A good cost report states totals, basis, variations and recommendations.
tasks.mistake: Reporting totals without basis loses trust.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Unrecorded Variations
caseStudy.background: A contractor delivered many small changes without written instructions. At the end, claims of £640,000 were disputed and the project ended in adjudication.
caseStudy.challenges: Variations weren't recorded or valued as they happened.
questions: Why did this become a dispute?
caseStudy.solution: Sterling introduced a variation register and requirement for written instruction and valuation within 14 days.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Record and value changes as they occur.
